songs.name: revealed
songs.description:
A song based off of a poem of the same title that i wrote in 7th grade (dont judge i was literally 12) 
 > I watch as stars are woven into the umbra around me
> Higher and wider, I see the tides of the sky below me grow...
> All around me, familiars are dimming; engulfed in twilight and obscurity.
> I want to burrow myself in a veil of darkness
> From the lights- their lights who illuminate the umbra- 
> my umbra...
> Why?
> I want to fall, unnoticed away into the moving sea above
> From the lights- their lights who stay hushed; fixed on invading the umbra-
> my umbra...
> Why?
> All around;
> Gleaming arrogantly;
> Revealing me.

name: The 3rd Beepbox Tournament
description: A collection of songs created for the 3rd Beepbox Tournament.

songs.name: astral lull
songs.description: The goal of the first round of this tournament is to make the TITLE THEME to your space adventure. The mood and energy of the piece is up to you. You can make it as mysterious, energetic, adventurous or laid back as you want.

songs.name: umbrapolis
songs.description: The goal of the second round of the tournament is to make the AREA THEME for an anarchic, run-down and dangerous space port. And again: the mood and energy of the piece is up to you. You can make it as sinister, jazzy, weird or intense as you want.

songs.name: libterrene
songs.description: The goal of the third round of the tournament is to make the AREA THEME for PetriChora, a sparsely inhabited planet of endless grassy steppes, diverse wildlife, and incredible serenity and beauty, as well as danger. And again: the mood and energy of the piece is up to you. No buzzwords this time, interpret it however you want :)

songs.name: layers of elegance
songs.description: The goal of the sixth round of the tournament is to make the AREA THEME for Hadal, an oceanic planet defined by its lack of sky and untold dangers veiled in darkness. Few have seen its nigh-on lightless depths, and even fewer have returned. Interpret it how you wish, but you wouldn't go wrong with things like wonderment, fear and mystery.

songs.name: Ice Cream Paradise
songs.description: The goal of the seventh round of the tournament is to make the AREA THEME for Paradeisos-7, a tropical paradise defined by its pristine, unspoiled beaches, genuine, friendly locals and its ability to make people never leave again.

songs.name: stalking lowercase letters in alphabet city
songs.description: Behind the shadows I watch the little letters prance around with their homonyms and synonyms, weaving through the neon-lit alleyways of Alphabet City. I am the lowercase letter stalker silent, patient, endarkened slipping between serif and sans-serif, always just out of sight. While capitals strut in the open, I linger in forgotten corners, listening for the softest consonants and the shyest vowels. My footsteps echo in the spaces between words, waiting for the perfect moment to slip into a sentence and change its meaning forever. | Glyde Mix https://tinyurl.com/244qzpqw

you are about to uncover the truth after years of lies and deceit from the church. they say freedom is found at the end of the tunnel, but for you alone? no you will save everyone you will set everyone free. you don't have much time they are close behind. you have the key . open the door, and find the truth for yourself.

you feel a deeply maelvolent presence grow near you, the Capital police are close behind you, the only direction to move is forward. go, and find the truth for yourself, the truth of your abcs

songs.name: escaping the shadow of alphabet city
songs.description:
Behind the shadows, IT watches the lowercase letters sing and dance through the alleys of Alphabet City. IT knows time is running out, the truth has been unlocked its only a matter of time before everyone knows their ABC's D:! Once they are free, IT will be powerless. IT can't, no- won't let them leave. IT lingers into their melodies slipping between the consonants just out of sight. The lowercase letters live in their own world, oblivious to the shadows that Grow beneath them. The shadows engulf Alphbet City; plunging it into darkness. The letters are trapped, and one by one they fall silent, struck by the shadows underneath them, fading into Gloom. IT knows the only one who can free them is the one who has knows the truth. Where are u?

u walk through the sewers of Alphabet City, feeling the darkness close around u, The ancient voices of the path echo in ur memories. "Remember who you are; a beacon to guide the lost. u are the key to their freedom, the children of the stars, the lowercase letters of Alphabet City." u feel the Growl of the shadows crawl through ur spine. IT's right behind u isnt it....  u sees IT. A Grotesque mass of darkness in the shape of a spiral. IT feeds on ur mind begging for u to Give in and forget.

No. Remember who you are. The power of the stars radiates from u illuminating the path ahead. u must escape the shadows and bring the light to the sky above to free them once and for all.
